::: {.info-box}
### Today
Lecture and discussion: transnational advocacy networks and corporate self-regulation — two different mechanisms for disciplining an MNE's supply chain when governments can't or won't. Starbucks appears as a brief illustration; the case for Wednesday is Patagonia.
:::

## Materials for today

- Keck & Sikkink 1999, "Transnational Advocacy Networks in International and Regional Politics"
- Villena & Gioia 2020, "[A More Sustainable Supply Chain](https://hbr.org/2020/03/a-more-sustainable-supply-chain)," *HBR*
